overview: ValuBrix is a premium AI-powered property intelligence platform for Bangalore real estate, delivering accurate valuations, area intelligence, distance/POI analysis, and specialized portals for buyers, sellers, and bankers — all powered by a dataset-trained engine with no hardcoded values.
features: Dataset-driven AI valuation engine with 19,200+ records
Separate ML models per property type (Apartment/Villa/Plot/Commercial)
Builder premium multiplier wired to final valuation
Correct PSF for all Bangalore micro-locations including outer periphery
Priority-based distance loading with OSRM routing
No POI result limits — all amenities within radius shown
WhatsApp lead form on all pages
Single core engine across all 8 portals
